# SOLIDWORKS Interop assemblies

These are the three redistributable Primary Interop Assemblies from the
SOLIDWORKS `api\redist` directory. They are used to build the add-in on machines
without SOLIDWORKS and are shipped with the installation package.

Assembly version: `33.5.0.53`

Files:

- `SolidWorks.Interop.sldworks.dll`
- `SolidWorks.Interop.swconst.dll`
- `SolidWorks.Interop.swpublished.dll`

All three binaries have valid Authenticode signatures issued to Dassault
Systemes SolidWorks Corp. Do not place other files from the SOLIDWORKS
installation in this directory.
